text:
A HUGE thank you to everyone who came out today in the pouring rain! You guys are the real ones. ❤️ Nothing stops the Shih Tzu community from showing up for their fellow Ewoks. 😂🐶

A special thank you to Château Le Woof for opening your doors and giving us a warm, dry place to gather. We’re so grateful for your kindness and for helping us make today happen! And a huge shoutout to Allie for taking charge of the megaphone and keeping our little army in line. 📣👑 Thank you to Brittney from @chompagne.co for the delicious treats and adorable bandanas. 

Rain or shine, the Ewoks always find a way to assemble!

Now it’s time to dry off, recover, and start planning the next one…

📅 The next NYC Shih Tzu Meetup is coming in early May! Mark your calendars, fellow Ewoks. We’ll see you in the spring! 🌸🐾
